items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I think Isaiah Morgan was playing trumpet at that time. Paul Barnes, Sidney Fowler, and the ! He was playing trumpet then. I think Isaiah Morgan was playing trumpet at that time. Paul Barnes, Sidney Fowler, and the ! Flosie, and Davis on drum. That was that set up.

ctx.x: Sam, no Sam Morgan was dead, but I don't know if he was dead, Andrew Morgan, trumpet player.

I think he's in over the lake now, Andrew. Yeah. No, Andrew, Andrew. Not Andrew, his brother, Isaiah, yeah, trumpet player. He passed. He passed, he died. I didn't know he died. Yeah, I didn't know Isaiah died. But let's see now, in the band, Roy Evans is the reason I asked, because I know he played with Sam .
